title: Sort each example into the correct form of power-sharing
instructions: Read each example and decide which of the four major forms of power-sharing it best illustrates.

bins.name: Horizontal — among organs
bins.description: Legislature, executive, judiciary — each at the same level checking the others (checks and balances).

bins.name: Vertical — among levels
bins.description: Among central, state and local governments at different levels.

bins.name: Among social groups
bins.description: Power shared with linguistic, religious or socially weaker groups via constitutional / legal arrangements.

bins.name: Among parties / pressure groups
bins.description: Multiple political parties, coalitions, interest groups and movements competing or sharing influence.
